premise: In a race across the rock pool Shrimp is too slow paddling forwards, so she curls up, flicks her tail and zooms to the finish backwards.
inspiration: Aesop's race fables (the hare and the tortoise) turned sideways: the smallest wins by doing it her own way, without even looking.
lesson: Your own way can be the fastest way.
learning: A shrimp zooms backwards by flicking its tail.

en-US.title: Backwards Shrimp
en-US.text: [excited] A race across the rock pool! {crab:enter} Crab was ready, {crab:face happy} claws up. {octopus:enter} Octopus was ready, all eight arms {octopus:live dance} wiggling. And little {shrimp:enter} Shrimp was ready too. {shrimp:pulse} Ready, steady… GO! {crab:go to pool another} Crab scuttled off sideways. {octopus:go to pool another} Octopus whooshed away. Shrimp paddled forwards with her tiny legs, paddle, paddle, paddle… {shrimp:face sad} but she was SO slow. [short pause] Then she had an idea. {shrimp:live flick hold} Shrimp curled up tight, {sfx:flick} and FLICK! {shrimp:live flick resume} She snapped out her fan tail and zoomed… backwards! {shrimp:live dart-back} Zip, zip, zip! Backwards past Octopus, {octopus:face surprised} backwards past Crab, {crab:face surprised} {shrimp:go to pool another backwards} backwards all the way across the pool. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:sparkle} [laughs] Shrimp had won, without even looking where she was going. {crab:live dance} Crab clicked his claws and danced. {octopus:hearts} [playfully] That's how shrimps go fastest, said Octopus. Backwards!

es-ES.title: La gamba que iba hacia atrás
es-ES.text: [excited] ¡Una carrera de punta a punta de la charca! {crab:enter} Cangrejo estaba listo, {crab:face happy} con las pinzas en alto. {octopus:enter} Pulpo estaba listo, con sus ocho brazos {octopus:live dance} meneándose. Y la pequeña {shrimp:enter} Gamba también estaba lista. {shrimp:pulse} Preparados, listos… ¡YA! {crab:go to pool another} Cangrejo salió de lado. {octopus:go to pool another} Pulpo salió zumbando. Gamba nadaba hacia delante con sus patitas, chap, chap, chap… {shrimp:face sad} pero iba TAN despacio. [short pause] Entonces tuvo una idea. {shrimp:live flick hold} Gamba se hizo una bolita, {sfx:flick} y ¡FLIC! {shrimp:live flick resume} Estiró de repente su cola de abanico y salió disparada… ¡hacia atrás! {shrimp:live dart-back} ¡Zis, zis, zis! Hacia atrás, pasó a Pulpo, {octopus:face surprised} hacia atrás pasó a Cangrejo, {crab:face surprised} {shrimp:go to pool another backwards} hacia atrás cruzó toda la charca. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:sparkle} [laughs] Gamba había ganado, sin mirar siquiera por dónde iba. {crab:live dance} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas y bailó. {octopus:hearts} [playfully] Así es como las gambas van más rápido, dijo Pulpo. ¡Hacia atrás!

ja-JP.title: うしろむきの エビさん
ja-JP.text: [excited]潮だまりで、きょうそう！{crab:enter}カニくんは、{crab:face happy}はさみを上げて、じゅんびばんたん。{octopus:enter}タコくんは、八本のうでを{octopus:live dance}くねくね。そして、小さな{shrimp:enter}エビさんも、やる気まんまん。{shrimp:pulse}よーい…ドン！{crab:go to pool another}カニくんは、よこにカサカサ。{octopus:go to pool another}タコくんは、すいーっ。エビさんは、小さなあしで、まえへせっせ、せっせ…{shrimp:face sad}でも、とってもおそいのです。[short pause]そのとき、ひらめきました。{shrimp:live flick hold}エビさんは、くるんとまるくなって、{sfx:flick}ぴしっ！{shrimp:live flick resume}おうぎのしっぽをぱっとひらくと…うしろへ、びゅーん！{shrimp:live dart-back}ぴゅっ、ぴゅっ、ぴゅっ！うしろむきのまま、タコくんをおいぬいて、{octopus:face surprised}カニくんもおいぬいて、{crab:face surprised}{shrimp:go to pool another backwards}潮だまりのむこうまで、ひとっとび。{shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:sparkle}[laughs]エビさんのかち！行くさきを、見てもいないのにね。{crab:live dance}カニくんは、はさみをカチカチならして、おどりました。{octopus:hearts}[playfully]「エビがいちばんはやいのはね…うしろむき！」 とタコくん。

de-DE.title: Die Rückwärts-Garnele
de-DE.text: [excited] Ein Wettrennen quer durch den Tümpel! {crab:enter} Die Krabbe war bereit, {crab:face happy} die Scheren hoch. {octopus:enter} Der Krake war bereit, und alle acht Arme {octopus:live dance} zappelten. Und die kleine {shrimp:enter} Garnele war auch bereit. {shrimp:pulse} Auf die Plätze, fertig… LOS! {crab:go to pool another} Die Krabbe flitzte seitwärts davon. {octopus:go to pool another} Der Krake sauste los. Die Garnele paddelte mit ihren winzigen Beinchen vorwärts, paddel, paddel, paddel… {shrimp:face sad} aber sie war SO langsam. [short pause] Da hatte sie eine Idee. {shrimp:live flick hold} Die Garnele rollte sich ganz fest zusammen, {sfx:flick} und ZACK! {shrimp:live flick resume} Sie klappte ihren Fächerschwanz auf und sauste… rückwärts! {shrimp:live dart-back} Wusch, wusch, wusch! Rückwärts am Kraken vorbei, {octopus:face surprised} rückwärts an der Krabbe vorbei, {crab:face surprised} {shrimp:go to pool another backwards} rückwärts quer durch den ganzen Tümpel. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:sparkle} [laughs] Die Garnele hatte gewonnen, ohne auch nur hinzuschauen, wohin sie schwamm. {crab:live dance} Die Krabbe klapperte mit den Scheren und tanzte. {octopus:hearts} [playfully] „So sind Garnelen am schnellsten“, sagte der Krake. „Rückwärts!“

fr-FR.title: Crevette à reculons
fr-FR.text: [excited] Une course d’un bout à l’autre de la mare ! {crab:enter} Crabe était prêt, {crab:face happy} les pinces en l’air. {octopus:enter} Pieuvre était prête, et ses huit bras {octopus:live dance} gigotaient. Et la petite {shrimp:enter} Crevette était prête, elle aussi. {shrimp:pulse} À vos marques, prêts… PARTEZ ! {crab:go to pool another} Crabe a filé de travers. {octopus:go to pool another} Pieuvre est partie comme une flèche. Crevette, elle, ramait en avant avec ses toutes petites pattes, rame, rame, rame… {shrimp:face sad} mais qu’elle était LENTE ! [short pause] Alors, elle a eu une idée. {shrimp:live flick hold} Crevette s’est roulée en boule, {sfx:flick} et CLAC ! {shrimp:live flick resume} D’un coup, elle a déplié sa queue en éventail, et elle a filé… à reculons ! {shrimp:live dart-back} Zoum, zoum, zoum ! À reculons, elle a dépassé Pieuvre, {octopus:face surprised} à reculons, elle a dépassé Crabe, {crab:face surprised} {shrimp:go to pool another backwards} et à reculons, elle a traversé toute la mare. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:sparkle} [laughs] Crevette avait gagné, sans même regarder où elle allait ! {crab:live dance} Crabe a fait claquer ses pinces et il a dansé. {octopus:hearts} [playfully] « C’est comme ça que les crevettes vont le plus vite, a dit Pieuvre. À reculons ! »

it-IT.title: Gamberetto va all'indietro
it-IT.text: [excited] Una gara da una parte all'altra della pozza! {crab:enter} Granchio era pronto, {crab:face happy} con le chele in alto. {octopus:enter} Polpo era pronto, con tutti e otto i tentacoli {octopus:live dance} che ballavano. E anche il piccolo {shrimp:enter} Gamberetto era pronto. {shrimp:pulse} Pronti, partenza… VIA! {crab:go to pool another} Granchio è partito di lato. {octopus:go to pool another} Polpo è schizzato via. Gamberetto remava in avanti con le sue zampette, ciaf, ciaf, ciaf… {shrimp:face sad} ma era TROPPO lento. [short pause] Poi gli è venuta un'idea. {shrimp:live flick hold} Gamberetto si è arrotolato stretto stretto, {sfx:flick} e… FLIC! {shrimp:live flick resume} Ha aperto di scatto la coda a ventaglio ed è sfrecciato… all'indietro! {shrimp:live dart-back} Zip, zip, zip! All'indietro ha superato Polpo, {octopus:face surprised} all'indietro ha superato Granchio, {crab:face surprised} {shrimp:go to pool another backwards} all'indietro ha attraversato tutta la pozza. {shrimp:face happy} {shrimp:sparkle} [laughs] Gamberetto aveva vinto, senza nemmeno guardare dove andava! {crab:live dance} Granchio ha fatto clic clac con le chele e si è messo a ballare. {octopus:hearts} [playfully] «Ecco come corrono più veloci i gamberetti», ha detto Polpo. «Come i gamberi: all'indietro!»

zh-TW.title: 小蝦倒退嚕
zh-TW.text: [excited]潮池大賽跑，要開始囉！{crab:enter}螃蟹準備好了，{crab:face happy}兩隻大螯高高舉起。{octopus:enter}章魚準備好了，八隻腳{octopus:live dance}扭來扭去。還有{shrimp:enter}小蝦，小不點也準備好了。{shrimp:pulse}預備——開始！{crab:go to pool another}螃蟹橫著身子，喀啦喀啦衝出去。{octopus:go to pool another}章魚咻——地往前游。小蝦用細細的小腳往前划，划呀划、划呀划……{shrimp:face sad}可是，好慢好慢喔。[short pause]這時候，牠想到一個好主意。{shrimp:live flick hold}小蝦把身體緊緊捲起來，{sfx:flick}然後——啪！{shrimp:live flick resume}扇子一樣的尾巴用力一彈，牠衝出去了……是倒著衝！{shrimp:live dart-back}咻、咻、咻！倒退嚕經過章魚，{octopus:face surprised}倒退嚕經過螃蟹，{crab:face surprised}{shrimp:go to pool another backwards}一路倒退嚕，穿過整個潮池。{shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:sparkle}[laughs]小蝦贏了！牠連看都沒看前面一眼呢。{crab:live dance}螃蟹喀喀敲著大螯，跳起舞來。{octopus:hearts}[playfully]章魚說：「小蝦游得最快的方法，就是——倒退嚕！」

zh-HK.title: 倒後衝的小蝦
zh-HK.text: [excited]石池裏，賽跑就要開始了！{crab:enter}螃蟹準備好了，{crab:face happy}高高舉起大鉗。{octopus:enter}八爪魚準備好了，八條手臂{octopus:live dance}扭呀扭。還有{shrimp:enter}小蝦，小小的，也準備好了。{shrimp:pulse}預備……起！{crab:go to pool another}螃蟹打橫一溜煙走了。{octopus:go to pool another}八爪魚呼的一聲游走了。小蝦用細細的腳向前划，划呀划，划呀划……{shrimp:face sad}可是，牠實在太——慢了。[short pause]忽然，牠想到一個好主意。{shrimp:live flick hold}小蝦把身子捲成一團，{sfx:flick}啪！{shrimp:live flick resume}扇子一樣的尾巴一彈，牠飛快地衝了出去……是倒後衝的！{shrimp:live dart-back}咻、咻、咻！倒後衝過八爪魚，{octopus:face surprised}倒後衝過螃蟹，{crab:face surprised}{shrimp:go to pool another backwards}一直倒後衝過了整個石池。{shrimp:face happy}{shrimp:sparkle}[laughs]小蝦贏了，連前面都沒看過一眼！{crab:live dance}螃蟹卡嚓卡嚓夾着鉗，跳起舞來。{octopus:hearts}[playfully]八爪魚說：「原來蝦仔要倒後游，先至最快㗎！」

flick.prompt: a quick little flick and splash of water in a rock pool, realistic
